reference_archetype.title: Rosa, Mechanized Wing Maiden (Unevolved)
reference_archetype.name: Rosa, Mechanized Wing Maiden (Unevolved)
reference_archetype.original_version: ブースターパック第5弾 永劫なる絶傑
reference_archetype.lore_en: "They say these brass pinions are too small for the heavens... yet just feeling the sunset breeze makes my heart soar!" — Rosa, calibrating her clockwork feather wings atop the Sky-Citadel terrace as a golden mechanical songbird alights upon her fingertips.
reference_archetype.lore_jp: 「この小さな真鍮の翼じゃ、まだ蒼穹には届かないって言うけれど……夕暮れの風を感じるだけで、こんなにも胸が高鳴るの！」――浮遊城塞のテラスで金色の機械小鳥を指先に留め、機構翼の少女・ローザは微笑む。

atelier_art_direction.morphological_brushwork_and_silhouette: Stylized 7.0-to-7.5-head anime proportions with articulated brass-gold and gunmetal mechanical pinions, sleek beveled cyber-magicite armor plates, tapered gauntlets, and translucent emerald/cyan energy feathers over warm sunlit cel-wash.
atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground clockwork feathers (+12px Z-relief), Midground heroine/knight silhouette (0px focal anchor), Background sky-citadel cloudsea (-14px atmospheric depth).
atelier_art_direction.card_frame_craft: Luxury SR (Super Rare · スーパーレア) collector frame with top-left octagonal cost gem (3), directional compass crest (N:7 E:8 S:6 W:7), smoked-glass bilingual nameplate, and embossed BP05-110 SR stamp.

collector_provenance.foil_treatment: Gunmetal-Silver Filigree Cold-Foil + Prismatic Pinion Shimmer

cards.lore_en: Inscribed in [BP01] Cradle of Echoes as collector slot BP01-003 LG, Mystic Mage channels Chrono-Arcana directional mastery (N:5 E:6 S:7 W:3) across the 3x3 stone monoliths of CARDFRONT: Cradle of Echoes.
cards.lore_jp: 『ブースターパック第1弾 響きの揺り籠』収録のコレクターズカード（BP01-003 LG）。秘術の星導師・ミスティックメイジはChrono-Arcanaの戦術共鳴を宿し、３×３の石盤上で四方（北5・東6・南7・西3）のテレグラフ支配を展開する。

atelier_art_direction.morphological_brushwork_and_silhouette: Stylized 7-head arcane proportions framed by interlocking astrolabe rings, dense G-pen sumi-e ink crosshatching over warm parchment-gold filigree, levitating grimoire pages, and vibrant watercolor cel-wash.
atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground tarot sigils and mana threads (+14px cold-foil mask), Midground spellcaster figure (0px crisp cel plane), Background observatory vault (-16px).
atelier_art_direction.card_frame_craft: Luxury LG (Legend · レジェンド) collector frame with top-left octagonal cost gem (3), directional compass crest (N:5 E:6 S:7 W:3), smoked-glass bilingual nameplate, and embossed BP01-003 LG stamp.

collector_provenance.foil_treatment: Ivalice Law Gold-Leaf Frame + Radiant Halo Spot-UV

atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground clockwork feathers (+12px Z-relief), Midground heroine/knight silhouette (0px focal anchor), Background sky-citadel cloudsea (-14px atmospheric depth).

collector_provenance.foil_treatment: Gunmetal-Silver Filigree Cold-Foil + Prismatic Pinion Shimmer

playable_hero_boss_16.lore_en: Cloaked in hexagonal optical camouflage along the rain-drenched highways of Neo-Arcadia, Shinobi strikes from outside the enemy's 90-degree radar cone. By the time the telemetry alert chimes, the capture is already sealed.
playable_hero_boss_16.lore_jp: ネオ・アルカディアの雨煙る高速道路を光学迷彩で疾走する電脳の影刃シノビ。敵の９０度索敵コーンの死角から音もなく忍び寄り、警報が鳴り響く前に捕獲を完遂する。

atelier_art_direction.morphological_brushwork_and_silhouette: Sleek 7-head stealth operative proportions, razor-sharp G-pen ink crosshatching, CMYK Ben-Day halftone screentone shadows, stark chiaroscuro negative space, and glowing crimson-amethyst optic trails.
atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground kunai tracers and radar reticle (+11px spot-UV gloss), Midground infiltrator silhouette (0px), Background rain-slicked Neo-Arcadia spire (-14px).
atelier_art_direction.card_frame_craft: Luxury SR (Super Rare · スーパーレア) collector frame with top-left octagonal cost gem (2), directional compass crest (N:7 E:6 S:6 W:5), smoked-glass bilingual nameplate, and embossed BP04-021 SR stamp.

h_chronos.original_version: ブースターパック第4弾 時空の聖域
h_chronos.lore_en: Keeper of the 1440-Frame Chrono Sanctum, Chronos conducts the planetary escapement gears that govern every turn clock. With one sweep of his pendulum staff, East, South, and West lanes lock into golden temporal stasis.
h_chronos.lore_jp: １４４０フレームの時空聖域を統べる歯車導師クロノス。惑星脱進機の律動を自在に操り、振り子の杖を一振りするだけで東・南・西の三戦線を黄金の時間停止へと封じる。

atelier_art_direction.morphological_brushwork_and_silhouette: Stylized 7-head arcane proportions framed by interlocking astrolabe rings, dense G-pen sumi-e ink crosshatching over warm parchment-gold filigree, levitating grimoire pages, and vibrant watercolor cel-wash.
atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground tarot sigils and mana threads (+14px cold-foil mask), Midground spellcaster figure (0px crisp cel plane), Background observatory vault (-16px).
atelier_art_direction.card_frame_craft: Luxury UR (Ultimate Rare · アルティメットレア) collector frame with top-left octagonal cost gem (4), directional compass crest (N:6 E:8 S:7 W:7), smoked-glass bilingual nameplate, and embossed BP04-007 UR stamp.

collector_provenance.foil_treatment: Astral Prismatic Cold-Foil + Textured Gold Leaf Emboss + Full-Bleed Borderless Etch

e_reaper.lore_jp: ３×３の石盤を生ける盤上とみなす紅蓮工房の異端戦術士。ヴェックスが振るう紅の刻印鎌は、東と南の二面を同時に薙ぎ払い、突出した聖騎士たちを鮮やかに反転捕獲する。

evolved_counterpart.lore_en: A renegade strategist of the Crimson Foundry who treats the 3x3 grid as a living chessboard of feints and counter-captures. Vex's 180-degree blood-rune cleave lures overconfident paladins into an inescapable East-South pincer. [Evolved Awakening: +1 All-Directional Resonance across the 3x3 Sanctum.]

atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground kunai tracers and radar reticle (+11px spot-UV gloss), Midground infiltrator silhouette (0px), Background rain-slicked Neo-Arcadia spire (-14px).

atelier_art_direction.morphological_brushwork_and_silhouette: Stylized 7.0-to-7.5-head anime proportions with articulated brass-gold and gunmetal mechanical pinions, sleek beveled cyber-magicite armor plates, tapered gauntlets, and translucent emerald/cyan energy feathers over warm sunlit cel-wash.
atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground clockwork feathers (+12px Z-relief), Midground heroine/knight silhouette (0px focal anchor), Background sky-citadel cloudsea (-14px atmospheric depth).
atelier_art_direction.card_frame_craft: Luxury SR (Super Rare · スーパーレア) collector frame with top-left octagonal cost gem (3), directional compass crest (N:8 E:5 S:8 W:7), smoked-glass bilingual nameplate, and embossed BP05-005 SR stamp.

collector_provenance.foil_treatment: Gunmetal-Silver Filigree Cold-Foil + Prismatic Pinion Shimmer

evolved_counterpart.lore_jp: 軌道メカベイと深淵海溝を繋ぐ次元の裂け目を泳ぐ海竜機リヴァイアサン。背びれの翠緑リアクターを臨界まで充填し、東方の戦線を一閃で貫くプラズマ奔流を放つ。【進化後覚醒：３×３聖域の四方ランクがすべて＋１共鳴上昇】

atelier_art_direction.parallax_25d_and_foil_layering: 3-plane 2.5D parallax depth map: Foreground clockwork feathers (+12px Z-relief), Midground heroine/knight silhouette (0px focal anchor), Background sky-citadel cloudsea (-14px atmospheric depth).
atelier_art_direction.card_frame_craft: Luxury SL (Super Legend · スーパーレジェンド) collector frame with top-left octagonal cost gem (4), directional compass crest (N:7 E:9 S:6 W:7), smoked-glass bilingual nameplate, and embossed BP05-088EV SL stamp.
